note: Production preset allowlist. A preset is served under MUSIC_RELEASE_PROFILE=commercial only when status is APPROVED here AND every model it runs passes release.validate_preset (approval, pinned hash, license). Add a preset by (1) building its pipeline, (2) registering a stage resolver in release.STAGE_RESOLVERS, (3) listing it here as VALIDATING, (4) promoting it to APPROVED after validation. 2026-10-08: commercial_2/6/13 set APPROVED by the project owner so the finished product can be built and tested under MUSIC_RELEASE_PROFILE=commercial; this is an owner decision, not independent legal clearance (open Mega53 weight-license evidence is documented as a blocker).
